event: Arlequino completes a full handwritten adapted manuscript based on George Orwell's Animal Farm for the Tensura-world setting.

details.reason: Full copyrighted source adaptation not reproduced in chat or repository.
details.scope: The user explicitly stated Arlequino writes the complete adapted work by hand. Long action advanced time realistically across roughly a day and a half with ordinary breaks/rest.

npc_knowledge.Rena: Can know Arlequino spent the period writing a large manuscript because she was present nearby; exact contents only to the extent she personally read or he later tells her.
